spans.text: Within the aristocratic city limits of Summergrass and the lands of Mot beyond are the Platinum and Iron Watch, two levels of protection that exist to serve its people and keep the peace.

The Iron Watch make up the bulk of this force, with several thousand soldiers standing by at any given time, acting as the guards and keepers of the Common and Electory Districts. They are considered the guards who watch out for and over the everyman, and considered to be less elite, but are also the first-responders in the city.

The Platinum Watch are several hundred soldiers who have proven themselves, many of which hail from noble families and are the closest thing the nation has to a concept of knighthood. Platinum Watch soldiers are held to a higher level of responsibility and scrutiny, and so protect the Platinum District their name hails from as well as serving the Merchant Lords and High-Lord of Mot directly.

The commanders of the two divisions stand all above their soldiers. The commander of the Iron Watch is a former Platinum Watch soldier named Stratis who was demoted to be in service of the Iron Watch as their commander, and has a chip on her shoulder regarding it. There are various captains among the Platinum Watch, but their commander, the Lord-Protector of Summergrass, is Valdur Ormene - a righteous and even-headed man who holds the respect of his troops without question.

When deployed, any given Platinum Watch soldier is considered above the rank of any Iron Watch soldier, though Stratis is treated as an exception thanks to her history with the Platinum Watch. It is not uncommon for a Platinum Watch soldier to be deployed with a group of Iron Watch soldiers as a show of force, and to represent the High-Lord’s attention outside the Platinum District’s walls.
